title: Meter Services Statement: Refund Window for PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Meter Error Refunds
content:
**1.** For a meter error refund on a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment, the refund window is set by the meter test history of the service account and by the time the enrollment has been active. The meter tests are those of the service account in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records (result fast or within tolerance, with the date each test was completed); the correction limit is the meter error correction limit in months of the underlying rate schedule.

**2.** Where an earlier meter test of the same service account found the meter within tolerance on or after the activation date and before the fast test, the refund window is the whole months from that earlier test to the current date, and never less than one month. The earlier test considered is the most recent test of the service account that found the meter within tolerance.

**3.** Where no such test exists and the enrollment was activated fewer than the correction-limit number of whole months before the current date, the refund window is one month more than the whole months since the activation.

**4.** An enrollment in any other situation keeps the correction limit of the underlying rate schedule as its refund window.

**5.** A window of a stated number of months takes the daily charge lines dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date. Whole months are complete calendar months counted from the earlier date to the current date.

### Test-history cases (hypothetical; correction limit 6 months, current date 25 May, fast test completed 20 May)

| Activation date | Most recent within-tolerance test | Refund window |
|---|---|---|
| 10 January | 2 March | 2 March to 25 May is 2 whole months: 2 months |
| 10 January | 28 April | 0 whole months, raised to the floor: 1 month |
| 10 January | none | 4 whole months since activation, fewer than 6: 5 months |
| 10 January | 15 December, before the activation | not on or after the activation, so as if none: 5 months |
| 2 September of the year before | none | 8 whole months, not fewer than 6: 6 months |
